from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection, with which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's bibliography; must match titles exactly as written")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    provided_papers: list[ProvidedPaper]
